markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (97%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal prediction, full model agreement, and clear simulated frozen-section margins [F7] support a routine Normal read.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Normal 97%, Invasive 2%, InSitu 1%, Benign 0% [F1] | Strongly favors Normal tissue |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at 90% target (test coverage 90%, ECE 5%, n=132) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 64th percentile OOD, 12/12 regions kept [F6] | Passes QC despite severity-3 blur |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (87–90% similarity) [F5]; contrast InSitu (81%) | All nearest reference cases match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 9, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (1.68, -1.27 contribution) strongly lowers invasive score [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 1) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (1.06, -0.42 contribution), but 0/20 AI spot check [F3] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (0.03, +0.31 contribution) slightly raises invasive score [F4] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.10, +0.28 contribution) slightly raises invasive score · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing 3 top-risk regions beat random removal (+0.0114 drop, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven classifier link (+0.0008 vs random, 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064); leans on Unreliable normal lobules (0/20 spot check).

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated severity-3 blur masks atypia; reliability only moderately ranks misclassified frozen sections (AUROC 0.70, n=1716).
- Focal in situ lesion resembles contrast case BACH_0043 (InSitu, 81% similarity) or involves the 97%-scored medial margin segment.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 4**: Inspect medial margin peak (97% segment score at x=0, y=512) and low tubule score.
2. **Regions 8, 9**: Check highest-risk area (region 8, 0.2% risk) and inferior margin peak (70% at x=768, y=1280).
3. **Regions 0, 1, 10**: Verify benign stroma and two-layered lobules directly, since the lobule concept is Unreliable.
